# Math Workspace

> Free browser-based scientific, engineering, numerical and research mathematics tools in English and Arabic.

Canonical site: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/
Sitemap: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/sitemap.xml

## Primary tools
- Scientific Calculator Online: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/scientific-calculator-online/
- Equation Solver Online: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/equation-solver/
- Engineering Calculator: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/engineering-calculator/
- Graphing Calculator: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/graphing-calculator/
- Engineering Unit Converter: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/unit-converter/
- Research Calculator: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/research-calculator/

## Engineering references
- Civil Engineering Formulas: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/civil-engineering-formulas/
- Hydraulics Formulas: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/hydraulics-formulas/

## Arabic
- حاسبة علمية أونلاين: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/ar/scientific-calculator/
- حل المعادلات أونلاين: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/ar/equation-solver/
- حاسبة هندسية أونلاين: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/ar/engineering-calculator/
- قوانين الهندسة المدنية: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/ar/civil-engineering-formulas/
- قوانين الهيدروليك: https://bimspecialist.github.io/Math/ar/hydraulics-formulas/

## Capabilities
Scientific calculator, complex numbers, equations and polynomial roots, graphing, unit conversion, matrices and numerical methods, exact rational arithmetic, measurement uncertainty, Student-t inference, linear regression, chi-square analysis, civil engineering formulas, hydraulics formulas, environmental engineering formulas, design and construction references, and advanced engineering mathematics.

## Accuracy and safety notes
General numerical and transcendental calculations use IEEE-754 double precision unless stated otherwise. Exact rational operations in Research Mode use BigInt within bounded workloads. Engineering references are educational/calculation aids and do not replace current governing codes, laboratory procedures, or signed professional design.
